description: A degree, a business, a house, a pension. Each requires believing the conditions in five years will resemble today's, and the evidence does not support that belief.
energy_note: Never starting the thing that takes five years.

aspect: So the horizon shortens to the next quarter
description: Short-horizon, low-commitment activity is the correct adaptation, and it is also the activity with no compounding returns - which is the mechanism by which a rational individual choice produces a stagnant aggregate.
energy_note: Everyone behaving sensibly, and nothing compounding.

aspect: Emigration becomes the only plan anyone has
description: When domestic accumulation does not work, japa is not aspiration but arithmetic - and it becomes the organising topic of a national conversation, affecting people who never go.
energy_note: A country where the only plan is the exit.

description: They planned 2023 and a two-bedroom in Magodo. Then fuel, then the naira, then her father's hospital deposit. They are still engaged, aged 34 and 31, living in separate family houses, and they have stopped naming a date.
